concept: Athena: Parquet and partitioning to reduce cost
tests: Which data optimizations reduce cost and speed up Athena queries.
expected: Columnar format (Parquet/ORC) + partitioning by frequently filtered columns — fewer bytes scanned. Triggers: "reduce query cost", "improve performance", "Athena".
why_not: Uncompressed CSV and a single large file increase the amount scanned; storage class does not change the per-scan cost.
